metas.name: 2026 · The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Tony
metas.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Young Washington
metas.description: A young George Washington faces war, betrayal and impossible choices that will forge a leader.
